headlines.title: IMF, 한국 성장률 2.6%로 상향 ‥"반도체 호조"
headlines.summary: [뉴스투데이] ◀ 앵커 ▶ 국제통화기금, IMF가 우리나라 올해 성장률 전망치를 2.6%로 전망했습니다. 지난 4월 전망치보다 크게 높아진 수치인데요. 유례없는 반도체산업 호황으로 인한 수출 호조세가 반영됐습니다. 이재욱 기자입니다. ◀ 리포트 ▶ IMF는 현지시각 8일 발표한 세계경제전망에서 한국의 올해 실질 국내총생산, GDP 증가율을 2.

headlines.title: IMF · ADB , 韓 성장률 2.6%로 상향 …반도체 훈풍 반영
headlines.summary: ADB, 올해 성장률 1.9→2.6%·내년 2.0%로 상향 IMF도 올해 전망치 2.6% 제시…국제기구 잇단 ‘눈높이 조정’ ADB “물가 2.7%”…국제유가·관세는 하방 위험 6월 수출이 1022억5000만달러를 기록하며 우리나라 월간 수출액이 사상 처음으로 1000억달러를 돌파한 가운데 반도체가 전체 수출의 44%를 책임지며 기록 경신을 이끌었다.

headlines.title: 정부, 17억유로 규모 유로화 표시 외평채 발행 성공…가산금리 '역대 최...
headlines.summary: 당초 제시한 가산금리 조건보다도 4bp 낮춰…올해 외평채 발행한도 모두 채워 사진제공=뉴스1 정부가 총 17억 유로(약 19억4000만 달러) 규모의 유로화 표시 외국환평형기금채권(외평채) 발행에 성공했다. 3년물과 7년물 모두 동일 만기 기준 역대 최저 가산금리로 발행했다.

headlines.title: 17억유로 외평채 최저 가산금리로 발행 … 올해들어 50억달러 확보
headlines.summary: 금년 만기 도래 외평채 11억달러 수준…39억달러 가까이 '여유' 유로화 [연합뉴스 자료사진] (세종=연합뉴스) 이세원 기자 = 정부는 17억유로(약 19억4천만달러·2조9천억원) 규모의 외국환평형기금채권(외평채)을 성공적으로 발행했다고 9일 발표했다. 재정경제부에 따르면 이번 외평채는 3년 만기 7억유로어치와 7년 만기 10억유로어치 두 종류로 발행됐다.

headlines.title: 정부, 17억 유로 규모 외평채 발행 성공 … 역대 최대
headlines.summary: 3년물 7억 유로, 7년물 10억 유로 발행 3년·7년물 모두 역대 최저 가산금리 기록 "글로벌 투자자들의 한국물 신뢰 재확인" [세종=뉴시스] 강종민 기자 = 세종시 어진동 정부세종청사 재정경제부. 2026.01.06. ppkjm@newsis.com [세종=뉴시스] 안호균 기자 = 정부가 사상 최대 규모의 유로화 표시 외국환평형기금채권 발행에 성공했다.

headlines.title: 1~5월 나라살림적자 54.2조 … 3년래 최저
headlines.summary: 국세수입 전년비 27.5조↑, 소득·법인세 호조 중앙정부 채무 1345.2조, 고유가 지원 등 확대 올해 1~5월 나라살림 적자가 54조원대를 기록하며 지난해와 비슷한 수준을 유지했다. 세수 호조로 총수입이 크게 늘었지만 고유가 피해지원금 등 추가경정예산 집행으로 지출도 함께 증가한 영향이다.

headlines.title: 전셋값 오르자 ‘ 매매 전환 ’ 현실로
headlines.summary: 서울 외곽중심 전세가율 가파른 상승 포모 추격 매수…신중한 접근 우려도 #. 690세대인 서울 도봉구 쌍문동 금호1차 아파트의 34㎡(이하 전용면적) 한 전세 물건의 호가는 2억3000만원으로 급매 매물의 호가(2억6000만원)와 3000만원밖에 차이가 나지 않는다.

headlines.title: 2주택자수 6월 들어 반등 … 3주택 이상은 감소
headlines.summary: 양도세 중과 재개에 다주택자 눈치싸움 2주택자 5000명 가까이 줄다 소폭 증가 3주택 이상 5개월째 감소, 稅부담에 처분 “다주택 정리과정” 이달말 세제개편 주목 지난달 2주택자 수가 소폭 반등했다. 다주택자 양도소득세 중과 재개를 앞두고 2월부터 5월까지 줄곧 감소세를 보였는데, 4개월 만에 다시 증가로 돌아선 것이다.

headlines.title: ‘ 초과이윤 ’ 지우고 AI 내세웠다…노동부, 사회연대임금 토론회 14일 개...
headlines.summary: AI 기술혁신 시대 사회혁신 의제 첫 공개 토론 노사·경영계·학계 참여, 유튜브 생중계 김영훈 고용노동부 장관이 27일 정부세종청사에서 열린 출입기자단 차담회에서 발언하고 있다. [고용노동부 제공] [헤럴드경제=김용훈 기자] 삼성전자의 성과급을 계기로 김영훈 고용노동부 장관이 제안했던 ‘한국형 사회연대임금’ 토론회가 오는 14일 열린다.

headlines.title: 정부, AI가 바꾸는 일자리 선제대응 … 5년간 100만명 직업훈련
headlines.summary: 산업전환 고용안정 로드맵 발표 신기술 이수 땐 '플러스 자격제' 인공지능(AI)이 일자리 지형을 빠르게 바꾸면서 정부가 처음으로 국가 차원의 '산업전환 고용 로드맵'을 내놨다. 향후 5년간 100만명 이상의 근로자와 구직자를 대상으로 AI 직업훈련을 실시하고, AI가 대체할 가능성이 높은 직종은 예측해 선제 대응하기로 했다.

headlines.title: AI·GX에 노동구조 급변 … '국민성장펀드' 6000억 추가 조성
headlines.summary: 제조업 82% 경영에 AI활용 못해 기후위기 고탄소 제조거점 충격 정의로운 전환 특별지구 신지정 정부가 '산업전환 고용안정 기본계획'을 내놓은 것은 인공지능(AI)과 탄소중립(GX), 저출생·고령화가 동시에 진행되면서 산업과 노동시장이 한 번도 경험하지 못한 구조 변화에 직면했다는 판단 때문이다.

headlines.title: 작년 외국인 입국 1위 베트남 … 중국, 2위로 처음 밀려나
headlines.summary: 제조업·건설업 경기부진에 취업입국 2년 연속 줄어…유학·일반연수만 9% 늘어 국제이동 129.6만명 3년만에 감소 한국 찾은 외국인 관광객들 [연합뉴스 자료사진] (세종=연합뉴스) 이대희 기자 = 지난해 외국인 입국 1위가 베트남으로, 통계 작성 이래 처음으로 중국을 제쳤다.

headlines.title: 외국인 입국 2위로 밀려난 '중국'…3위는 '미국'
headlines.summary: 인천공항. 사진=연합뉴스 지난해 한국에 입국한 외국인 가운데 베트남 국적자가 처음으로 중국을 제치고 가장 많은 비중을 차지한 것으로 나타났다. 국내 제조업과 건설업 경기 둔화 등 영향으로 취업을 목적으로 입국한 외국인은 2년 연속 감소했다.

headlines.title: 베트남, 중국 제치고 외국인 입국 1위 … 외국인 순유입 1년 새 절반 감소

top5_headlines.title: 2주택자수 6월 들어 반등 … 3주택 이상은 감소

key_headlines.title: IMF Raises Korea's 2026 Growth Forecast to 2.6% on Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: The International Monetary Fund significantly raised South Korea's economic growth forecast to 2.6% for 2026, up from April's projection, reflecting strong semiconductor export performance and industry recovery.

key_headlines.title: Government Launches Industrial Transition Employment Stabilization Plan Amid AI and Green Energy Transformation
key_headlines.summary: The government announced a comprehensive plan to address labor market disruptions from AI adoption and carbon neutrality goals, including a National Growth Fund expansion and employment shock monitoring system.

key_headlines.title: Korea Successfully Issues 1.7 Billion Euros in Foreign Exchange Stabilization Bonds
key_headlines.summary: The government issued 1.7 billion euros of foreign exchange bonds at the lowest spread rate, securing approximately 5 billion dollars in external funding for the year.

key_headlines.title: Two-Home Owners Show Slight Recovery in June Ahead of Capital Gains Tax Increases
key_headlines.summary: The number of two-home owners rebounded slightly in June after four consecutive months of decline, as multi-home owners positioned ahead of anticipated capital gains tax increases.

key_headlines.title: Vietnamese Nationals Surpass Chinese as Top Foreign Visitors to Korea
key_headlines.summary: Vietnamese nationals became the largest foreign visitor group to Korea in 2025, surpassing Chinese visitors, while employment-related immigration declined for the second consecutive year due to domestic manufacturing slowdown.

sections.Hot Economy News: Korea's economic outlook has brightened significantly with the IMF raising the 2026 growth forecast to 2.6%, driven by exceptional semiconductor industry performance and robust export momentum. The government is simultaneously preparing for unprecedented structural changes in labor markets caused by AI adoption and green energy transition, announcing a comprehensive employment stabilization plan with expanded social safety nets. Foreign exchange reserves remain solid with the successful issuance of 1.7 billion euros in bonds, providing financial stability. Multi-home real estate transactions show mixed signals as owners strategically position before expected tax policy changes. Foreign visitor composition is shifting with Vietnamese nationals now leading instead of Chinese visitors, reflecting changing migration patterns.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Citibank forecasts the Bank of Korea will raise its base rate by 0.25 percentage points in July, considering upward GDP revisions, solid Q2 economic indicators, and lower oil prices offsetting inflation concerns. Consumer price inflation expectations remain modest at around 2.7% or below due to declining international oil prices. The Korean Wave exports grew significantly by 16% year-over-year to 19.75 billion dollars in 2025, supported by popular cultural content including Squid Game: The Hunterverse. Consumer price index components are being revised to reflect evolving consumption patterns, with maratang (spicy noodle soup) and childcare services replacing traditional items like peanuts and doraji. The government maintains its cautious stance on household debt management, keeping lending volume restrictions in place despite improved nominal GDP growth.
sections.Financial Markets: Korean stock markets experienced significant volatility with both KOSPI and KOSDAQ triggering sell-side circuit breakers as indices fell over 5%, signaling market uncertainty and triggering automatic trading halts. Recent market concerns center on whether the recent highs represent a market peak amid semiconductor stock corrections and global portfolio rebalancing, with foreign investors taking profits after May's gains. Global investment banks like UBS have made aggressive recommendations to short Korean domestic stocks while buying SK Hynix ADRs, reflecting bearish sentiment on the broader market. The KOSPI trades at historically depressed valuation multiples comparable to financial crisis levels, creating debate about investment opportunities versus downside risks. US Treasury yields have risen to their highest levels since May amid renewed US-Iran military tensions, affecting global capital flows and domestic interest rate expectations.
sections.Industry & Technology: Semiconductor platforms proven in electric vehicle and autonomous driving applications are accelerating the commercialization timeline for humanoid robots and advanced robotics, with Texas Instruments leveraging automotive innovation to solve robotic challenges. Hyundai developed a high-speed integrated stacking system for EV batteries that consolidates manufacturing from seven stages into one, significantly improving production efficiency and safety. EV Parts is participating in government-backed battery performance evaluation system enhancements for recycled EV batteries, supporting the circular economy for electric vehicles. Korea secured three new regulatory sandbox zones in Gyeongbuk province focused on AI-based battery safety verification and international standardization, signaling continued investment in future industries. Elon Musk's xAI unveiled Grok 4.5, an AI coding model claiming GPT-level performance at half the cost, developed jointly with Cursor to compete with leading AI companies.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices rose 0.30% in the first week of July, while speculative buying concentrated in Guri and Giheung ahead of anticipated triple regulatory measures including comprehensive real estate policies. Banks are implementing stricter mortgage loan management policies, with major institutions tightening credit standards despite rising apartment prices, leaving younger buyers struggling to secure adequate financing. Financial authorities maintained hawkish lending policies despite improved economic growth, citing the need to address household debt concerns and preventing speculative real estate bubbles. Two-home owners showed strategic buying patterns before tax policy changes, while three-home owners continued liquidating positions over five consecutive months due to capital gains tax burden increases. Pre-lease demand remains concentrated in transit-oriented, school district-focused, and large-scale complexes as investors seek to rebalance their real estate portfolios.
sections.International Economy: US-Iran military tensions have resurfaced, causing international oil prices to surge 5.2% to above 78 dollars per barrel and adding geopolitical risk premiums to global markets. Trump administration demands NATO members increase defense spending to 5% of GDP, marking a significant shift in alliance cost-sharing expectations amid ongoing NATO summit discussions. The Federal Reserve's new leadership under Kevin Powell showed hawkish tendencies in recent FOMC minutes, with some members discussing potential rate increases as AI investment emerges as an inflation concern. Spain and other European nations face pressure to increase military expenditures, with Trump threatening trade restrictions and tariffs on non-compliant allies rather than traditional diplomatic persuasion. Global capital flows remain sensitive to changing US monetary policy signals and geopolitical tensions, affecting emerging markets including Korea.
sections.AI & Economy: The government established an AI employment impact monitoring system to detect labor market changes early and proactively respond to AI-driven job displacement with wage subsidy and income protection measures. The AI industrial transformation (AX) initiative, combined with green energy transition (GX), is reshaping labor markets through a 'new social contract' framework distributing AI-generated growth benefits through employment stabilization funds and retraining programs. Government designated special zones in carbon-intensive industrial regions like coal-dependent areas for just transition support, providing targeted assistance for affected workers and communities during AI adoption. Ulsan launched a public-private council for AI industrial transformation, positioning itself as a hub for AI adoption in manufacturing sectors. Manufacturing sector penetration of AI remains limited at 18%, indicating significant adoption potential but also highlighting workforce readiness challenges.
sections.Others: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy secured 120 billion dollars in NATO summit support commitments, strengthening international backing for long-term defense capabilities amid continued Russian military challenges. Chinese cosmetics brands expanded market presence in Korea through aggressive pricing and diverse color cosmetic offerings, with imports rising 27.4% to 491 million dollars in the first five months of 2026. Shinhan Investment Securities committed 17.1 billion won in information security investments to strengthen cybersecurity defenses against AI-era threats and sophisticated cyber attacks. Russia faces mounting economic challenges with acknowledged fuel shortages, forcing purchases from India and Kazakhstan while reducing diesel export capacity as a major crude oil exporter. Turkey's bilateral gifts and trade commitments create diplomatic complexities, with countries navigating domestic import restrictions and international regulations on accepting high-value defense equipment.
